title: Rav, Son of Shmuel
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Midrash Tehillim, beginning of chapter 9, saying in Shmuel’s name: “‘Very good’ — this is the evil inclination.” Seder HaDorot, under the entry Rabbah bar Shmuel, cites the Midrash and holds that the reading should be Rabbah bar Shmuel.

notes.text: The supplied quotation has טוב מאור. The OYW digital Midrash Tehillim 9:1 reads טוב מאד, “very good,” from Genesis 1:31, followed by “this is the evil inclination.” The translation follows that matching sense and retains the supplied form here; the printed Hyman letters remain unverified. The same digital paragraph fully writes “Rav son of Shmuel in the name of Rabbi Shmuel,” a title difference from the supplied plain Shmuel.

The consulted scan of Hyman, volume III, printed p. 1039, reads טוב מאוד (“very good”), supporting the English quotation. The frozen transcription’s טוב מאור is retained in the Hebrew source and in the earlier note; it is not silently substituted here. The consulted OYW Midrash Tehillim 9:1 reads טוב מאד and names Rav son of Shmuel reporting Rabbi Shmuel. The locally cached Seder HaDorot entry Rabbah bar Shmuel explicitly calls the former name an error and says it should read Rabbah bar Shmuel. That remains Seder HaDorot’s proposed correction, not an admitted identity. The earlier note’s pending inspection predates the printed-page review.
